env_paras.distribution: SD1 or SD2; used consistently for online generation and dataset lookup
env_paras.num_jobs: Positive integer; size code is jobs followed by two-digit machine count
env_paras.batch_size: Parallel training instances; reused for paraller updates with fresh policy rollouts

model_paras.embedding_dim: Independent direct projections map operation/machine/pair inputs of 6/5/4 dimensions to this width; 128 gives a 384-dimensional actor input; supplementary state descriptors are always included
model_paras.head_num: Attention heads; embedding_dim/head_num must be an even integer for RoPE
model_paras.dropout: Must be zero so PPO rollout and update log probabilities agree
model_paras.use_future_demand: Enable FRDT's explicit future demand and associated delay channels
model_paras.use_delay_propagation: Enable action-conditioned relaxed delay propagation inside FRDT; requires use_future_demand=true

train_paras.lr: Fixed Adam learning rate throughout training
train_paras.gamma: Use 1.0 for the undiscounted makespan objective
train_paras.gae_lambda: GAE trace parameter; advantages are normalized globally across all transitions in the complete rollout
train_paras.A_coeff: Fixed coefficient of the clipped PPO policy loss
train_paras.entropy_mode: structural_kl enables ASER; shannon is the fixed-entropy ablation
train_paras.entropy_coeff: Initial adaptive ASER coefficient; fixed coefficient for the Shannon ablation
train_paras.kl_target: ASER normalized KL-to-job-balanced-reference target for exploration
train_paras.max_iterations: Number of fresh-rollout PPO updates; must cover at least one validation interval
train_paras.paraller: Resample all batch_size training instances every this many updates; 50 reuses each batch for 50 fresh rollouts
train_paras.save_timestep: Validation interval in updates; save the best model on validation improvement
train_paras.minibatch_size: Transitions per gradient-accumulation chunk; one optimizer step per PPO epoch after processing the full rollout

test_paras.distribution: Training-model distribution and default distribution for a bare data_path size code; null inherits env_paras.distribution
test_paras.num_jobs: Training-model job count only; null inherits env_paras.num_jobs; does not select or restrict test data
test_paras.num_mas: Training-model machine count only; null inherits env_paras.num_mas; does not select or restrict test data
test_paras.data_path: Test directory independent of model size: 3010, SD1/4010, data_test/SD2/3010, Public, or an absolute path; reference size is read from instances
test_paras.sample: false=greedy; true=best of num_sample independent schedules
test_paras.num_sample: Number of sampled schedules per instance
test_paras.public_ins: Legacy Public shortcut only when data_path is absent; use data_path=Public to select public benchmarks

train_seed: Random seed for model initialization, training-instance generation, rollout sampling, and PPO updates
test_seed: Random seed for testing sampled evaluation
